text: Olyve Longtemps is a Breton patron of the Wayside Inn in Wind Keep.
Oleen-Tul is an Argonian commoner residing in the city of Windhelm. He has no unique dialogue.
Old Snapper is a crocodile that appears in the region of Deshaan in .
Olquamir is an Altmer member of the Mages Guild. He serves as the magister of their branch in Firsthold.
Old Snagara is a unique Echatere found at Poacher's Encampment. She is an extremely powerful enemy. Defeating her will complete Poacher's Encampment.
Olmarinn is a Nord found in the Hubalajad Palace in the city of Abah's Landing, Hew's Bane. He can be seen talking to Daiharri, but is impossible to interact with.
Olveidi the Ratmaster is a Nord vampire found at the Ratmaster's Prowl. There, she leads her own pack of rabid skeevers.
Omeeta is an Argonian member of the Fighters Guild. She serves as the armsman of their branch in Stormhold. She is the author of Crafting Motif 45: Mazzatun Style.
Old Man Richarde is a Breton found on the shore between Mesanthano's Tower and Trapjaw's Cove. He believes the Vestige to be a mudcrab in disguise, and is followed by a mudcrab of his own.
Old Marienne is a Breton residing in Kerbol's Hollow. She can be found near the town's gates.
Olivie Notte is a Breton noble found at the party at the At-Tura Estate.
Olivier Gimbert is a Breton warrior residing in Hissmir, Shadowfen.
Olwenna Ice-Wind is a Nord soldier with the Ebonheart Pact stationed at Fort Virak, Stonefals.
Olyn Nolar is a Dunmer residing in the Warehouse District of Abah's Landing.
Old Sihadid is a Redguard smith residing in the Craglorn city of Belkarth.

Old Frikkhild is a Nord artisan found inside her family home in Windhelm. She is the only resident left in the house, and is probably the oldest member of the Coldheart family, and the namesake for Frikkhild Coldheart. She has no unique dialogue.
Old Gwilherm is an Orsimer blacksmith residing in Shornhelm.
Olffik is a Nord hired as a guard at the Fulstrom Homestead.
Olfjarda is a Nord hired as a guard at the Fulstrom Homestead.
Ollslid is a Nord and a survivor of the Worm Cult on Treva's Farm.
Oluth was one of the many Skraws that rebelled against the lords of Umbriel.
Olnewil is an Altmer found east of the southern docks of Shimmerene, Summerset during the quest "The Queen's Decree." After completing her quest-related dialogue, she cannot be interacted with.
Olunandon is an Altmer residing in the city of Shimmerene, Summerset.
Olivier Reynaud is a Breton who can be found in the Illumination Academy in Summerset. He assumed the role of Torchbug from Brave Little Scrib.
Old Man Chimere, also known as Chimere Graegyn, is a human conjuror encountered in .
Oleed-Tah is an Argonian member of the Bright-Throat Tribe who can be found at the docks in Bright-Throat Village, Murkmire.
Olorime is an Altmer member of the Welkynar who can be found in Cloudrest, alongside her gryphon Darremalatu.
Oleen-Xu is an Argonian residing at Mach-Taeed's House in Lilmoth.
Olfrig is an Orsimer cultist encountered inside the Ashurnibibi ruins in . He is a member of Malacath Fanatics.
Olduzah the Cutter is a character located in Alik'r Desert, Hammerfell, in .
Old Ri'jhaad is a Senche-raht located in Dune, Reaper's March, in . He was introduced as part of the prologue for .
The Orb Guardian was an Auroran under the command of Umaril the Unfeathered during the Auroran Crisis, who may have been Umaril's second-in-command.

Ontus Vanin is a retired Imperial who is said to have spent 40 years in the Arcane University. He mentions that he likes to "sleep late and read trashy books." He also apparently "cares nothing about the Mages Guild," although he is a former member of it. He also wears White Mage's Robes.
Onmi Hard-Mouth is a Nord Commoner residing at his house in the town of Dagon Fel.

Optio Bologra is an Orsimer found in Gnisis Drillmaster in the West Gash. He is a member of the Imperial Legion, where he trains other soldiers and the Nerevarine for payment. He resides in the Gnisis Barracks in the training room on the lower floor.
Orag gra-Bargol is an Orcish spell merchant at the Chapel of Stendarr in Chorrol. *Vital Stats: **Mercantile: 5 **Speechcraft: 28
Orcish Invader is a type of hostile Orsimer in . Many are encountered during the quest "Waking Nightmare" in Nightcaller Temple.
Orakh gro-Badbu is an Orsimer Barbarian and slaver residing in the stronghold of Hlormaren. He is located on the bottom level of the stronghold's keep.
Orbath gro-Agdurz is an Orsimer who resides on the island of Betnikh.
Opatieel is an Argonian tailor residing in Davon's Watch in the region of Stonefalls. He runs a tailoring stall called Swamp-Stitch Tailors.
Ontogu gro-Bashnarz is an Orsimer blacksmith and member of the local Fighters Guild residing in the city of Elden Root, Grahtwood. He can be found at the forge at the local branch, selling his wares.
Onglor is a Bosmer residing in Redfur Trading Post in Grahtwood.
Oosh is an Argonian residing in the Redfur Trading Post in the region of Grahtwood.
Onuja is an Argonian scout working under Garyn Indoril. He was sent to Othrenis in order to gather information of how to bind Balreth. He appears very cowardly and easily startled.
Ordinator Gorili is a Dunmer ordinator. She is part of the team assisting the Ebonheart Pact forces at Eidolon's Hollow.
Ophalia Strong-Voice is a Nord bard performing in Mournhold. She is the daughter of Ophanta.
Ophanta is a Nord residing in Mournhold. She is the mother of Ophalia Strong-Voice.
Orcolag is an Orsimer member of the Mages Guild residing in the guildhall in the city of Hallin's Stand.
Orea Lledas is a Dunmer afflicted with the Llodos Plague. She is found at the improvised camp for those affected within the catacombs beneath Quarantine Serk.
Ordinator Areth is a Dunmer Ordinator. He is part of the team assisting the Ebonheart Pact forces at Eidolon's Hollow.
Ordinator Muron is a Dunmer ordinator. He is part of the team assisting the Ebonheart Pact forces at Eidolon's Hollow.
Orama Sadas is a Dunmer residing in the city of Windhelm who guards Tildsi Mothran and her daughter Nurara Mothran. She cannot be interacted with.
Ordooth the Corruptor is a powerful Orsimer of the Iron Orcs clan found inside Exarch's Stronghold.
Ordinator Guard is a Dunmer guard residing in the city of Mournhold.
Oorzuka is an Orsimer banker residing in the city of Orsinium, proprietor of The Iron Vault in the Orsinium Fighters Guild building.
Ordatha is an Orsimer priestess of Trinimac found in the Temple of Ire in the city of Orsinium. She can not be interacted with, but can be overheard giving a reading from the book of Trinimac.
Ondrisa is a Breton residing in the outlaws refuge underneath the city of Daggerfall.
Open-Hands is an Argonian beggar found by the docks in Abah's Landing.
Onurai-Maht is an Argonian guild trader found at All That Glitters in Anvil, Gold Coast.
Oraneth is a Bosmer in who resides in Spinner Aldor's House in Deepwoods, Malabal Tor.
Oonama is a Khajiit commoner residing in Mistral, Khenarthi's Roost. She can be found admiring the bard Eye-Fancy.
Ordinator Nethis is a Dunmer ordinator found in Iliath Temple.
Ongalion is a Bosmer member of the Falinesti Faithful. He is found at the Falinesti Autumn Site.
Orchelos is a Bosmer residing in Karthdar, first met in its Sacred Cave during the events of "Pact Advocate."
Ording is a Bosmer residing in Karthdar, first met in the Sacred Cave.
Onfroi Zammes is a Breton noble found at the party at the At-Tura Estate.
Onri Tustin is a Breton clothier and a member of the Daggerfall Covenant. He sells his wares at the Armory Merchants at the Northern High Rock Gate.
Ordinator Da'ravis was a Dunmer ordinator. His spirit and soul are encountered in the Reservoir of Souls at Eidolon's Hollow.
Orator Salothran is a Dunmer spirit found at the group boss location Salothan's Council. Defeating her along with her three companions rewards the achievement Salothan's Cursebreaker.
Order Hunter is a generic character residing in the Gold Coast.

Oorol was an under-chef in Qijne's kitchen whose territory was Ghol Manor. His second-in-command was an Umbrielian named Minn. He managed to entertain Ghol for the better part of a year. However, Qijne eventually decapitated him with her filet knife because Lord Ghol was bored by his prandium for the fourth time in a row. Missing an under-chef in the kitchen, Qijne ordered Slyr to take Oorol's station and to bring Annaïg with her.
Ontagoor the Ravenous is a Xivkyn in . She may be found patrolling the Imperial City Sewers. She primarily uses melee attacks.
Ondunlmo is an Altmer who can be found in a vanguard camp near Sea Keep in Summerset. He cannot be interacted with.
Oodegu is an Orsimer found inside Hightide Hollow. He is the boss of that delve, and defeating him counts towards clearing the Explore Hightide Hollow achievement.
Orc Adventurer Captain is an Orc in charge of a group of adventurers who have entered the Shivering Isles.
Order Battlemage is a generic member of Order of the Hour who can be found in several locations in .
Ordasha is an Orc guild trader who runs Ordasha's Respectable Wares found at the Guild Market in Lilmoth, Murkmire.
Oolfil is a Spiderkith found in the outlaws refuge of Fargrave. He plays dice with Tysena.

Oorza is an Orsimer mystic, and resides in Alcaire Castle, in the region Stormhaven. She owns and operates a stall, Implements of Magecraft, in the Castle's local marketplace, where she sells various magical items.
Orero Omothan is a Dunmer smith and a Retainer with House Redoran who operates a shop outside the Ald Velothi Outpost in the small seaside village of Ald Velothi.
Orok gro-Ghoth is an Orsimer who lives in Chorrol and works as a steward at the castle. He is one of the suspects in the theft of a painting from the Countess.

Othrok was a former Baron of Dwynnen. He fought against the Camoran Usurper. Baron Othrok was the leader of the Order of the Raven in 3E 267 against the Camoran Usurper, in the Battle of Firewaves, and was responsible for defeating him there. Today, the Bretons honor this victory during Othroktide, celebrated on the 5th of Sun's Dawn.
Orns Omaren is a Dunmer trader who resides in Molag Mar, Morrowind. He operates a small Alchemical supply store at the St. Veloth's Hostel, and is not involved in any quests.

Owyn is the current blademaster of the Arena. He is a Redguard with a short temper and a stabbing wit. He is very jaded, often taunting the Hero by stating that he does not believe they will survive the next fight, for example: "You see to it that the people of Cyrodiil get some entertainment, and I'll see to it that you get a decent burial!" However, as Owyn is presumably short-tempered and irreverent with all those he speaks to, this is probably not meant as a personal insult. As the Hero advances through the ranks of the Arena, Owyn becomes more and more friendly. He has asked the Battle Matron, Ysabel Andronicus, to marry him but she refused saying "I'm old, not desperate."
Count Ormellius Goldwine, also known as the Count of Kvatch, was the ruler of the city Kvatch.

Orgnolf Hairy-Legs is an ill-tempered Nord commoner and porter working in Castle Chorrol. He is one of the suspects who appears to have stolen a valuable painting belonged to the Countess Arriana Valga. He does not offer any services or training.
Orinthal is a Redguard assassin who resides in the city of Bliss, New Sheoth in the Shivering Isles.
Orgnar is a Nord cook and bartender of the Sleeping Giant Inn in Riverwood.
Orla is a Nord priestess of Dibella at the Temple of Dibella in Markarth.
Orini Dral is a Dunmer bodyguard for Sarthis Idren, a skooma producer and dealer operating out of the warehouse in Riften.
Orthe is a Dremora who resides inside Mankar Camoran's Paradise Grotto.
Otius Loran is an Imperial priest residing in the town of Chorrol.
Otumeel is an Argonian living in the city of Leyawiin. His house can be found near the House For Sale.

Orvas Dren is a Dunmer warrior, the younger brother of Duke Vedam Dren, and the uncle of Ilmeni Dren. He lives on the Dren Plantation, north of Vivec City and east of Pelagiad. He has no formal position in House Hlaalu, but is a wealthy criminal and the Kingpin of the Camonna Tong. He owns a large group of slaves who work at his plantation.
Lord Oresme was a commander of Sentinel in the Third Era. He surrendered to Daggerfall, later committing suicide.

Orthjolf is a Nord vampire of the Volkihar Clan and one of Lord Harkon's primary advisors. He and fellow senior vampire Vingalmo are embroiled in a feud over the throne, and can be often heard making cutting remarks towards one another.

Ovis Velas is a Dunmer mage found in the Great Bazaar district of Mournhold during the quest "The Summoner." He carries a key to his family's home, Velas Manor, in Godsreach where later his brother Gavis Velas can be found.
Orothea is a Breton residing in Koeglin Village, Stormhaven.
Orvona Vadryon is a Dunmer pilgrim who resides in the Vivec, St. Delyn Canton.
Overseer Melur is a Dunmer member of House Dres residing at their farmstead outside Mournhold.
Oromin is an Altmer member of the Thalmor in who is found at their headquarters in Woodhearth. He is later found at the Seaside Sanctuary and then called to Hectahame.
Ormilus is an Altmer residing in Port Hunding, Stros M'Kai. He is sitting outside Headman Bhosek's Palace.
Ourson is a Breton residing in Bad Man's Hallows, Glenumbra. He is found praying under the large tree.
Ormvard is a Nord barbarian and member of the false Skaal tribe on Solstheim. He can be found either in the Raven Rock Mine or wandering the wilds of the Hirstaang Forest region.
Orsone is a parrot in . He belongs to Gerrick, and can be found perched beside him at Gerrick's Goods.
Othigu is an Orsimer who resides at The Watch House in Davon's Watch, Stonefalls.
Ostarand was an Ayleid hero who set out to hide the Prismatic Crystal. He recounted his experience in his diary.
Orthalon is a traveling Bosmer merchant found on the road east of Southpoint, in the region of Grahtwood.
Orthenir is a Bosmer and one of the last member of the Wooded Eye found in Rootwater Grove, Greenshade.
Orkideh is a Redguard clothier residing in the city of Kozanset, Alik'r Desert. She can be found at her shop, Noonday Sun Clothiers, selling her wares.
Orenwen is an Altmer member of the Star-Gazers found at their observatory in Belkarth.
Oscar Lielleve is a Breton member of the Mages guild. He is found at their branch in Belkarth.
Orrun is a Redguard member of the Fighters Guild who resides at the hall in the city of Sentinel.
Othohoth is an Orsimer backpack merchant working at Otho's Packs and Pouches in the city of Evermore.
Ornis Verobar is a Dunmer alchemist residing in Quarantine Serk. He is conducting various experiments in order to find a cure to the Llodos Plague
Orvana Marethi is a Dunmer first found at the docks of Mournhold. She is encountered again after she is admitted into Shad Astula.
Oruude is an Altmer fence residing in the Davon's Watch Outlaws Refuge.
Overseer Grexev is a Dremora found in the Village of the Lost in Coldharbour.
Orgdugrash the Snappy is an Orsimer residing in the city of Windhelm.
Orilu is a Dunmer Ashlander of the Mabrigash Tribe. She is found at their village located in the Vale of the Ghost Snake.

Otho Numida is an Imperial and one of the three members of Empress Regent Clivia Tharn's Elite Guard. He and his companions first appear friendly but later turns hostile in the main library of the White-Gold Tower.
Otholug gro-Goldfolly is an Orsimer vampire found in the Vile Drainage of the Imperial City Sewers. He is the leader of a group of Orcish vampires, and serves as a Group Boss.
Osheeja is an Argonian residing in the Mournhold Outlaws Refuge underneath Mournhold.
Ozozur is a non-hostile Scamp owned by Gaireth at the Skywatch Mages Guild.
Otried is a Nord member of the Fighters Guild. She is the armsman of their guildhall in Shor's Stone.
Oubelic Gane is a Breton fighting in the Thizzrini Arena, Reaper's March.
Ostarion is a Altmer bard performing at the Baandari Trading Post.
Oriadess is a Bosmer residing in the Shrouded Vale, in the region of Greenshade.
Othanron is a Bosmer commoner residing in the city of Woodhearth.
Ottaesa is a Nord merchant. She sells her wares at her stall, Ottaesa's Imports, in Alten Corimont.
Oruzkad is a Troll found with Runescriber Kulth at the Exarch's Stronghold in Craglorn.
Orianel is a Bosmer found at Trader's Rest in Velyn Harbor, Malabal Tor.
Ozzozachar is a Daedric Titan, and may sometimes appear at Dark Anchors. He is the favored Titan of Coldharbour, and called the son of Molag Bal.
Othbekha is a Orsimer carpenter and proprietor of Fort Breaker's Arms in the Bangkorai Garrison, Bangkorai.
Othukul is an Orsimer magus found on the second floor of the Orsinium Mages Guild main hall in the city of Orsinium. He is a member of the Mages Guild.
Osgulug is an Orsimer drunkard found in the city of Orsinium. He has no unique dialogue.
Orutha is an Orsimer commoner found working in Ufgel's Bathhouse and Laundry in the city of Orsinium.

Orzorga, formerly known as Commander Orzorga, is a professional Orsimer chef found in Morkuldin Haven. She specializes in Orcish cuisine and runs the tavern Orzorga's Kitchen, also in the Morkul Haven. She tasks the Vestige with fetching ingredients for dishes that she is making for an upcoming feast in Orsinium, as her assistant is running late.
Otumi-Wulm is an Argonian residing in the city of Stormhold.
Othzog is an Orsimer found in the Loose Tooth Lodge in Stonetooth Fortress.

Ovidius Celatus is an Imperial found at the Hackdirt refugee camp. He is the former mayor of the town, but was forced to resign when him and his people were ousted by the Black Daggers when they took over.
Orval Uveran is a Dunmer noble residing inside his house in Anvil. He cannot be interacted with.
Orquan is an Altmer farmer residing in Phaer. He has no unique dialogue.
Ormurrel is an Altmer priest residing in the Temple of the Eight in Grahtwood.
Osianne Chatillon is a Breton found resting inside St. Pelin's Chapel in Evermore.
Ouida Delatte is a Breton member of the Evermore City Guard. She is part of the squad that was sent to Murcien's Hamlet to investigate the Reachmen presence there. She cannot be interacted with.

Owen Pavelle is a Breton and a member of the Daggerfall Covenant. He was part of the squad that went into the crypts at Bonestrewn Crest. When the squad leader, Sir Valcent Tailies, turned on his own men, Owen managed to lock himself inside a nearby steel cage in order to escape him.
Otroggar is a Nord fisherman found fishing at the Bleakrock Village docks. He is killed during the Daggerfall Covenant attack on the village.
Overseer Aruz is a Dremora found at the Tower of Lies. He is tasked with keeping the prisoners in check. When killed, he drops Daedra Husks and Daedra Hearts.
Oryla Heryon is a Dunmer merchant. She sells her wares at her stall, Cabbage & Tambourine, at the Merchant Caravans of Fort Amol.
Orinthus is an Imperial member of the Saltwalker Militia. He is found at their camp in the Alik'r Desert.
Ostrala Veturius is an Imperial patron of the Loose Tooth Lodge in the Stonetooth Fortress.
Otho Rufinus is an Imperial poacher found at his camp east of Goldfolly.
Overseer Shiralas is a Dunmer overseer in charge of handling the construction of Vivec City who may be found in Pilgrim's Approach. She has been married to Varona Beloren for five years.
Ortvar Bonebreaker is a Nord member of the Stormfist Clan. He is found in the Secluded Sewers when the Clan occupies the location.
Othora is a Nord member of the Fighters Guild. She is found at their guildhall in Stormhold.
Ottglund is a Nord warrior and patron of The Tapped Vein in Shor's Stone.
Overseer Llovyn is a Dunmer residing in Sadrith Mora, Vvardenfell.
Osanna Merick is a Breton residing in Molag Mar on Vvardenfell.
Orrnar Redoran is a Dunmer noble and member of the Fighters Guild residing at the local guildhall in Windhelm, Eastmarch.
Overdreamer Chartrand is a member of the Supernal Dreamers in Vaermina's Shrine.
Orninlusea is an Altmer bard found in the city of Shimmerene, Summerset. She sings and plays the lute.
Orgdragog is an Orsimer is a member of the Ropefish residing in Sadrith Mora, Vvardenfell.

Oriandra is an Imperial member of the Psijic Order who initially leads the Vestige through the tutorial quest "The Mind Trap." After escaping it, she can be found in Prisoner's Hold outside of Shimmerene.
Othgozag is an Orsimer commoner residing in Orsinium, in Ufgel's House. She has no unique dialogue.
Orluguk is an Orsimer noble and daughter of Lurg, residing beneath Exile's Barrow in .
Othulg is an Orsimer bartender residing in Hallin's Stand, Bangkorai, in .
Orzik the Storm-Born is a Harpy boss that appears in . She can be found along with Talonclaw and Fleshrender in the southern interior of Old Orsinium.
Oxildutsei is an Argonian in who can be found at the Solitude Outlaws Refuge underneath Solitude.
Orthuna is an Orsimer member of the Merethic Society trying to curate a collection of antiquities at Rulanyil's Fall.

King Orthor (also spelled Oftor) was the Nordic king of Winterhold during the fifth century of the Third Era. He was a terrible drunk and an infamous sex fiend. Queen Elysana of Wayrest is his second cousin.
Otha Thielde is a Breton druid of the Eldertide Circle in . She can be found arguing with her brother Perryn Thielde at one of their possible locations accross the High Isle and Amenos.

Ottolf is a Nord encountered in a camp at the Hordrek's Hunting Grounds. He is staying there with his husband Steirvald and mother-in-law Ingjard, who brought both of them outdoors to teach them how to live in the wilderness. When the werewolves attack their camp, he is threatened by Vig with a bow. His father is a miller.
Overseer Jahi is a character located in the Rain Catcher Fields, Alik'r Desert, in .
Overseer Severus is a character located in Onsi's Breath, Bangkorai, in .
Othloth Salavel is a hostile Dunmer encountered outside Balmora. He is a leader of a gang.
Ozrog is an Orsimer residing in Alcaire Castle, located outside the Old Goat Inn.

Palonirya is an Altmer clothing merchant who has a shop in the Imperial City Market District. She is the proprietor of Divine Elegance, an upper class clothing store. She is considered a brilliant fashion designer (her clothing designs are even worn by counts and countesses). She is a tough negotiator and the Master Trainer in Mercantile. To receive her training services, the Hero must have 10,000 on hand. Once she has raised the Hero's Mercantile skill to 75, the option to invest in shops will appear.
Patababi is a Dunmer scout living in Zainab Camp, in Morrowind. Patababi is a member of the Ashlanders faction.
Pallia Ceno is an Imperial agent, skill trainer, and novice member of the Imperial Cult. She can be found wandering the village of Hla Oad armed with an Imperial Shortsword should anything go awry.
Parwen is a Bosmer archer and member of the Fighters Guild in Skingrad. She does not offer any training or services but is noted for her extreme dislike of Goblins.
Pajeen is an Argonian worshiper of the Daedric Prince Boethiah, and can be found at his shrine.
Pad-Ei is an Argonian rogue who resides at The Choosy Beggar, an inn in the city of Bliss. He spends all of his time drinking on the first floor of the inn, and is never seen sleeping by the Hero.
Pania Cadiusus is an Imperial Noble who resides in Nchuleftingth, Morrowind.
Pactur is a Nord, and the overseer of Rockwallow Mine, which is east of Morthal.
Pantea Ateia is the Imperial Master Vocalist at the Bards College, in Solitude.

Paratus Decimius is an Imperial Mage in who operates at the Dwemer Ruins of Mzulft. He is the last surviving member of the Synod expedition to Mzulft regarding information about the Oculory and the leader of the expedition.

The Paatru were a breed of Argonian that lived in the innermost areas of Black Marsh and did not have much contact with outside races or the Imperial government that operated on the fringes of Black Marsh. They were described as looking toad-like. The Paatru were also xenophobic and were known to kill foreigners who they encountered.
Palevius Lex is an Elder Imperial sailor found at the Water Stone with his fellow shipmates Benkum, Hjalfar, and Liesl.
Parmanir is an Altmer brewer residing in the Auridon city of Vulkhel Guard. He can be found in the Salted Wings Tavern.
Parisse Lozieres is a Breton residing in Daggerfall, Glenumbra. She can be found around Daggerfall Docks waiting for her shipments.
Padier Renoit is a Breton residing in Dreughside outside Wayrest in Stormhaven. He's escaped the attack of the dreugh and is located in the Arbogasque's Home.
Palmur-dra is a Khajiit armsman. He sells his wares at his stall at the Temple of the Crescent Moons.
Parmtilir is an Altmer found in Ezduiin, an ancient Ayleid Ruin.
Palomir is an Altmer residing in Skywatch,Auridon. He is a member of the Veiled Heritance and acts as a recruiter for them in the city.
Paints-with-Dreams is an Argonian farmer residing in the city of Mournhold, raking the ground near the Mournhold Mages Guild.
Pacheeva is an Argonian mystic and member of the Mages Guild residing in the town of Bergama. He is found at the local branch, selling his wares.
Pale-Hide is a guar residing in the region of Bal Foyen. He is a member of Esqoo's Guar herd, who considers them to be his family.
Pamaea is a Khajiit blacksmith residing in the city of Mistral, Khenarthi's Roost. She can be found at the Moonfire Forge, selling her wares.

Panreth is a Bosmer member of the Fighters Guild found in the hall in Rawl'kha. In her note, Make the Wilds Safer, Earn Gold, she refers to herself as, "Panreth the Bold, Freelance Hunter and Benefactor."
Pash-Riha is an Argonian warrior who resides in Stonefalls. She is Elder Seven-Bellies´ sister and can be found near Lukiul Uxith.
Parham the Wary is a Redguard residing in the city of Sentinel.
Pale-Heart is an Argonian member of the Shadowscales residing in Hissmir, Shadowfen. __NOTOC__
Pain-Giver is an Argonian member of the Fighters Guild residing in the city of Riften.
Parvaia is a Redguard guild trader working at Lake Honrich Holdings in the city of Riften.
Pamolwe is an Altmer laborer found working at the Abecean Saddle Company in Vulkhel Guard.
Parmbarel is an Altmer pack merchant residing in Velyn Harbor. His store is called Parmbarel's Hold-Alls.
Pale Squnque is a Troll that can be found in Troll's Toothpick in .
Panhandler Thomas is a Breton pauper residing in Daggerfall. He is saved by the Vestige from a Werewolf attack by the river, during the quest "Back-Alley Murders."
Padeel is an Argonian member of the Fighters Guild residing in the city of Stormhold.
Pabla Taloet is a Breton laborer found listening to a speech by Sir Khnanya at-Salan halfway down to the Daggerfall Docks. She has no unique dialogue.
Paawelaya is a Khajiit Outlaw found at the Sharper's Alley in Abah's Landing.

Panardil is a Maormer beggar in the Bazaar district of Abah's Landing, Hew's Bane. She is found against a wall of Gemane's House, begging in an alley across from the north entrance of Jamadin's House.
Pad-Maxath is an Argonian who can be found near Mane and Muzzle in Kvatch. She cannot be interacted with.
Pale-Eyes is an Argonian found at the Hackdirt Refugee Camp in Cyrodiil.
Parash is an Argonian keeping watch and taking care of those buried at the Deep Graves.
Parenel is a Bosmer smith residing in Rawl'kha. Although their class is a smith, they do not sell any Blacksmithing items.
Paldrin the Wise is a Reachman of the Bloodthorn Cult. He serves Angof the Gravesinger as his champion in the Cliffs of Failure.
Parquier Gimbert is an alcoholic Breton and the keeper, along with his wife Frederique, of the Westwind Lighthouse.
Parriot Badouin is a Breton sailor. He is found at the docks near Murcien's Hamlet, which is used to travel to Blackheart Haven.
Parriot Conele is a Breton found with his companion Abadai at their campsite in the Reaper's March.
Pascual Boissart is a Breton residing in the Baandari Trading Post.
Pantea Vettiena is an Imperial outlaw found behind the warehouses in the docks in Anvil. She cannot be interacted with.

Pelagius Septim III, born as Thoriz Pelagius Septim, also known as Pelagius the Mad, and the Mad Emperor, was the Jarl of Solitude, and the twelfth Emperor of Tamriel and a member of the Septim Dynasty. When Pelagius was just over a year old, Emperor Antiochus Septim died and his daughter, Kintyra, assumed the throne to the acclaim of all. Kintyra II was Pelagius' cousin and an accomplished mystic and sorceress. Kintyra II's reign was usurped by her and Pelagius' cousin Uriel, by the power of his mother, Potema, the so-called "Wolf Queen of Solitude", during the War of the Red Diamond. Pelagius Septim II was the sixth ruler of the third Empire of Tamriel.

Pelagius Septim was the second ruler of the Septim Empire, and Tiber Septim's grandson. He ruled Tamriel for less than three years; however, he was still seen to be as strong of a ruler as his grandfather had been. It is said that, had he not been killed, the rule of Pelagius could have continued the Golden Age of Tamriel.

Percius Mercius is an Imperial Drillmaster, and steward of the Fighters Guild in Ald'ruhn. He gives the Nerevarine the most difficult initial quest of any Fighters Guild steward. He also offers advice on most Fighters Guild quests.
Perennia Draconis is an Imperial farmer living on the Applewatch farm. She is a poor old woman with four moved-out children and only has her dog Jake with her now.
